title: S1S2 model package manifest (s1s2.manifest/1), package spec 0.2-draft
description: Structural layer of the S1S2 package manifest. Cross-field rules a JSON Schema cannot express (placeholder order, marker/delimiter agreement, embeddings size, one head per question type per build, escalation targets, label/token counts) are normative in spec/s1s2-package.md and enforced by validateManifest (src/manifest.ts); `s1s2 validate` runs both.

lead.description: Text appended after the rendered prompt before the level tokens are read by the logits readout (heads keep their read positions). Absent: " " when the tokenizer writes the space before each level as its own token, else "".

license.description: SPDX license expression of the package as distributed.

lab.description: Free-form notes from the training setup (prompts, label contract, heads). Ignored by the runtime.

confidence.description: Confidence definition answers report (spec 5.1); reserved hook until a comparison of confidence definitions is done, ignored by s1s2 0.1.

modalities.description: Inputs `decide` takes. Absent = ["text"] (a text manifest). A media package (no text sections) lists "audio" and/or "image" and needs repo + revision. See spec/MULTIMODAL.md.

repo.description: Media packages: where the pinned files live (Hub repo id, or a name mapped by baseUrls / localDirs).

revision.description: Media packages: pinned commit sha, or "local" for an unpublished package.

^x-.description: Vendor extensions. Ignored by the runtime.

path.description: Repo-relative path (no leading '/', no '..' segment, no scheme) or an absolute https URL.

scale.description: Reader scale of a pointer head (spec 6.1): used when the head.bin header states none; default 1/sqrt(headDim) (alias3-web).

devices.description: Where the build was checked to run: webgpu (browser GPU), wasm (browser CPU, onnxruntime-web WASM), cpu (Node onnxruntime-node), cuda. For genai, wasm and cpu are opt-in (listed only after the packager measured that path); readers may fall back from webgpu to wasm when WebGPU is absent.

dtype.description: Weight precision of the graph, e.g. int4, int8, q4f16_1, fp16.

norm.description: Out-of-graph final RMSNorm (spec 6.5): hiddenOutput is pre-norm; the runtime applies it before heads read.

attention.description: Attention of the decision pass (spec 7); s1s2 0.1 refuses noncausal builds.

source.description: Format the package was converted from, declared by the converter (never guessed from file names).

decoderReader.description: Language (choice) or spoken term (predicate) read with the Qwen3-ASR decoder from the tower's final vectors; needs audio.decoder. See spec/MULTIMODAL.md section 9.

cpuBuild.description: The decoder built for CPU kernels (Node CPU, browser WASM).

imageSpec.description: Image decision reader (Qwen3-VL + LoRA; questions with 2 to 26 lettered options, read by the LM-head logit of the option letter). See spec/MULTIMODAL.md section 10.
